# Check option documentation against the property that the implementation reads

Historical 1171 documents options.addPermission but actually reads options?.permissionPrompt. Later 1265 removes this per-call knob when introducing the Thunderbird pref; accepted documentation contains addToHistory and principal instead. Scoped API recommendation: compare every option key and its default with both implementation and callers. Do not perpetuate either obsolete permission key as a current option or infer reviewer approval from landing alone. This is source and test inspection only. Full Bugzilla and historical review discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran.

Scope: mail/modules/LinkHelper.sys.mjs.
